# [Beta] List borrow markets on all networks
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/list-borrow-markets

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. Lists borrow markets with per-asset `supplyRate`, `borrowRate` and `utilizationRate` (decimal fractions), totals supplied/borrowed (base units + USD), caps and risk parameters. No default network scope (all networks). Filters on collateral/borrow assets, protocols and TVL (USD); if you send both an allow and a deny filter, the allow filter wins. Unknown asset filters are echoed in `errors.unsupportedCollateralAssets` / `unsupportedBorrowAssets`. Paginated: `perPage` 1-1000. The trailing-slash-free path /beta/borrow/markets also works. Collateral-only `assetsData` entries (`assetConfig.isBorrowEnabled=false`, e.g. Morpho market collateral) OMIT `totalSupplied`, `totalBorrowed`, `supplyRate`, `borrowRate` and `utilizationRate`: read them with `.get()`, and take market size from the borrowable asset's entry. Cost: 6 credits. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/list-borrow-markets.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/borrow/markets/`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 6 credits ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `listBorrowMarkets`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `page` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `0` | Zero-based page index (default 0). Request the response's `nextPage` until that key is absent (it is omitted, never null, on the last page); a page past the end returns 200 with empty `data`. There is no total count. |
| `perPage` | query | integer (> 0, ≤ 1000) | no | `50` | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 50). 0 or more than 1000 returns 400. |
| `allowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to include, by name (e.g. `base`). Omit for all networks. Names only: CAIP-2 IDs such as `eip155:1` return 400 (invalid_enum_value) on /beta/borrow/*. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedNetworks=a&allowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to exclude, by name only (e.g. `base`). CAIP-2 IDs are NOT accepted on /beta/borrow/* (400 invalid_enum_value). Ignored when `allowedNetworks` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedNetworks=a&disallowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedCollateralAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to include by collateral asset (symbol, name or address). Repeat the key once per value (`allowedCollateralAssets=a&allowedCollateralAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedCollateralAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedCollateralAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to exclude by collateral asset (symbol, name or address). Ignored when `allowedCollateralAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedCollateralAssets=a&disallowedCollateralAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedCollateralAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedBorrowAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to include by borrowable asset (symbol, name or address). Repeat the key once per value (`allowedBorrowAssets=a&allowedBorrowAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedBorrowAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedBorrowAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to exclude by borrowable asset (symbol, name or address). Ignored when `allowedBorrowAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedBorrowAssets=a&disallowedBorrowAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedBorrowAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to include: protocol `name` or exact `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. A name matches EVERY protocolId with that name: `morpho` = `morpho-metamorpho` (Morpho V1 / MetaMorpho vaults) + `morpho-v2` (Morpho V2 vaults) + `morpho-market` (borrow markets); `aave` matches 8 protocolIds. Use the protocolId to select one product, e.g. `morpho-metamorpho` for Morpho V1 only, or `aave-collateral vault-v3` for Aave v3 (it contains a space: send `aave-collateral%20vault-v3`). Guessed IDs such as `aave-v3` return 200 with empty `data` and the value in `errors.unsupportedProtocols`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedProtocols=a&allowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to exclude, by `name` or `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. Ignored when `allowedProtocols` is set (the allow-list wins). Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedProtocols=a&disallowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `minTvl` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | — | Minimum market TVL in whole USD (integer), computed from total supplied assets. No default. |
| `maxTvl` | query | integer | no | — | Maximum TVL in whole USD (integer), computed from total supplied assets. |

# [Beta] Get rate and liquidity history of a market asset
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/get-borrow-market-historical-data

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. Returns a time series for one asset of one borrow market: `supplyRate`, `borrowRate`, `utilizationRate` (decimal fractions), totals supplied/borrowed (base units + USD), indexes, `timestamp` (Unix seconds). Oldest first from `fromTimestamp` (default 0). Paginated (`perPage` up to 20000). Cost: 3 credits + 3 per data point. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/get-borrow-market-historical-data.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/borrow/markets/historical/{network}/{marketId}/{assetId}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 3 credits + 3 per data point ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `getBorrowMarketHistoricalData`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `network` | path | string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Network name (e.g. `base`, `mainnet`). This endpoint accepts names only, not CAIP-2 IDs. |
| `marketId` | path | string | yes | — | Borrow market ID `<rootAddress>-<marketHash>`: `data[].marketId` from GET /beta/borrow/markets/. |
| `assetId` | path | string | yes | — | Asset ID within the market: `assetsData[].marketAssetId` from the market list (the token address). |
| `page` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `0` | Zero-based page index (default 0). Request the response's `nextPage` until that key is absent (it is omitted, never null, on the last page); a page past the end returns 200 with empty `data`. There is no total count. |
| `perPage` | query | integer (> 0, ≤ 20000) | no | `50` | Items per page, 1-20000 (default 50). 0 or more than 20000 returns 400. Every returned item is billed (see x-credits); request only what you need. |
| `granularity` | query | string: `1hour`, `1day`, `1week` | no | `"1hour"` | Spacing between returned points: 1hour, 1day or 1week (default 1hour). Points align to even intervals from Unix epoch 0. Each point is billed, so coarser granularity is cheaper. |
| `fromTimestamp` | query | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 99999999999) | no | `0` | Start of the window, Unix seconds (not milliseconds; values >= 1e11 return 400). Default 0 = start of history, so page 0 holds the OLDEST data: pass a recent timestamp for recent data. Results are oldest first. |
| `toTimestamp` | query | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 99999999999) | no | — | End of the window, Unix seconds (not milliseconds). Default: now. A value before fromTimestamp returns 200 with empty data. |

# [Beta] Get live rates and liquidity of a market asset
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/get-borrow-market-asset-nrt-data

Cost: 1 credit. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/get-borrow-market-asset-nrt-data.

# [Beta] List borrow markets on one network
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/list-borrow-markets-by-network

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. Same as /beta/borrow/markets/ restricted to one network (name only, e.g. `base`; CAIP-2 not accepted on borrow endpoints). Paginated: `perPage` 1-1000. Collateral-only `assetsData` entries (`assetConfig.isBorrowEnabled=false`, e.g. Morpho market collateral) OMIT `totalSupplied`, `totalBorrowed`, `supplyRate`, `borrowRate` and `utilizationRate`: read them with `.get()`, and take market size from the borrowable asset's entry. Cost: 6 credits. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/list-borrow-markets-by-network.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/borrow/markets/{network}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 6 credits ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `listBorrowMarketsByNetwork`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `network` | path | string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Network name (e.g. `base`, `mainnet`). This endpoint accepts names only, not CAIP-2 IDs. |
| `page` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `0` | Zero-based page index (default 0). Request the response's `nextPage` until that key is absent (it is omitted, never null, on the last page); a page past the end returns 200 with empty `data`. There is no total count. |
| `perPage` | query | integer (> 0, ≤ 1000) | no | `50` | Items per page, 1-1000 (default 50). 0 or more than 1000 returns 400. |
| `allowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to include, by name (e.g. `base`). Omit for all networks. Names only: CAIP-2 IDs such as `eip155:1` return 400 (invalid_enum_value) on /beta/borrow/*. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedNetworks=a&allowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to exclude, by name only (e.g. `base`). CAIP-2 IDs are NOT accepted on /beta/borrow/* (400 invalid_enum_value). Ignored when `allowedNetworks` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedNetworks=a&disallowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedCollateralAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to include by collateral asset (symbol, name or address). Repeat the key once per value (`allowedCollateralAssets=a&allowedCollateralAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedCollateralAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedCollateralAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to exclude by collateral asset (symbol, name or address). Ignored when `allowedCollateralAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedCollateralAssets=a&disallowedCollateralAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedCollateralAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedBorrowAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to include by borrowable asset (symbol, name or address). Repeat the key once per value (`allowedBorrowAssets=a&allowedBorrowAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedBorrowAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedBorrowAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Markets to exclude by borrowable asset (symbol, name or address). Ignored when `allowedBorrowAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedBorrowAssets=a&disallowedBorrowAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedBorrowAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to include: protocol `name` or exact `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. A name matches EVERY protocolId with that name: `morpho` = `morpho-metamorpho` (Morpho V1 / MetaMorpho vaults) + `morpho-v2` (Morpho V2 vaults) + `morpho-market` (borrow markets); `aave` matches 8 protocolIds. Use the protocolId to select one product, e.g. `morpho-metamorpho` for Morpho V1 only, or `aave-collateral vault-v3` for Aave v3 (it contains a space: send `aave-collateral%20vault-v3`). Guessed IDs such as `aave-v3` return 200 with empty `data` and the value in `errors.unsupportedProtocols`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedProtocols=a&allowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to exclude, by `name` or `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. Ignored when `allowedProtocols` is set (the allow-list wins). Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedProtocols=a&disallowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `minTvl` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | — | Minimum market TVL in whole USD (integer), computed from total supplied assets. No default. |
| `maxTvl` | query | integer | no | — | Maximum TVL in whole USD (integer), computed from total supplied assets. |

# [Beta] List a wallet's borrow-market positions
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/list-borrow-positions

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. Lists a wallet's borrow-market positions with supplied/borrowed balances per asset (base units + USD), `healthFactor` and `ltv`. In `assets[]`, `balanceNative` is the wallet's balance; the position is `suppliedNative` and `borrowedNative`. Not paginated. Use the per-market endpoints for supply-only positions in a known market. Cost: 6 credits. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/borrow-markets/list-borrow-positions.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/borrow/portfolio/positions/{userAddress}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 6 credits ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `listBorrowPositions`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `userAddress` | path | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | — | Wallet address whose data is returned. EVM address: 0x + 40 hex characters (checksum optional). ENS names such as vitalik.eth are not resolved (400). |
| `allowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to include, by name (e.g. `base`). Omit for all networks. Names only: CAIP-2 IDs such as `eip155:1` return 400 (invalid_enum_value) on /beta/borrow/*. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedNetworks=a&allowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 22 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to exclude, by name only (e.g. `base`). CAIP-2 IDs are NOT accepted on /beta/borrow/* (400 invalid_enum_value). Ignored when `allowedNetworks` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedNetworks=a&disallowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to include, by symbol, name or address. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedAssets=a&allowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to exclude, by symbol, name or address. Ignored when `allowedAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedAssets=a&disallowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `minUsdAssetValueThreshold` | query | number (≥ 0) | no | `1` | Ignore supplied or borrowed market assets worth less than this many USD (default 1). |
| `sortBy` | query | string: `balanceUsd` | no | — | Sort key: `balanceUsd` (position/balance value in USD). Case-sensitive. |
| `sortOrder` | query | string: `asc`, `desc` | no | `"asc"` | Sort direction, `asc` or `desc` (lowercase; `DESC` returns 400). Default `asc`: pass `desc` to get the highest values first. |

# [Beta] List Pendle fixed-term (PT) markets
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/fixed-term-pendle/list-fixed-term-pendle-markets

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. Lists active Pendle principal-token markets with `fixedApy` (decimal fraction), `expiry` (Unix seconds), `tvl` and `liquidity` (USD strings). Defaults: allowedNetworks = base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism; minTvl = 100000; sortBy = tvl; sortOrder = desc (this endpoint defaults to desc, unlike the others). `search` is a case-insensitive substring match on the market name, underlying protocol name and network name. Paginated. Cost: 1 credit + 3 per market returned. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/fixed-term-pendle/list-fixed-term-pendle-markets.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/fixed-term/`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 1 credit + 3 per market returned ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `listFixedTermMarkets`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `page` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `0` | Zero-based page index (default 0). Request the response's `nextPage` until that key is absent (it is omitted, never null, on the last page); a page past the end returns 200 with empty `data`. There is no total count. |
| `perPage` | query | integer (> 0, ≤ 5000) | no | `50` | Items per page, 1-5000 (default 50). 0 or more than 5000 returns 400. Every returned item is billed (see x-credits); request only what you need. |
| `allowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to include, by ticker symbol (case-insensitive, e.g. `USDC`); token addresses are NOT accepted and are echoed in `errors.unsupportedAssets`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedAssets=a&allowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to exclude, by ticker symbol. Ignored when `allowedAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedAssets=a&disallowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to include: protocol `name` or exact `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. A name matches EVERY protocolId with that name: `morpho` = `morpho-metamorpho` (Morpho V1 / MetaMorpho vaults) + `morpho-v2` (Morpho V2 vaults) + `morpho-market` (borrow markets); `aave` matches 8 protocolIds. Use the protocolId to select one product, e.g. `morpho-metamorpho` for Morpho V1 only, or `aave-collateral vault-v3` for Aave v3 (it contains a space: send `aave-collateral%20vault-v3`). Guessed IDs such as `aave-v3` return 200 with empty `data` and the value in `errors.unsupportedProtocols`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedProtocols=a&allowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to exclude, by `name` or `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. Ignored when `allowedProtocols` is set (the allow-list wins). Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedProtocols=a&disallowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `minTvl` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `100000` | Minimum vault TVL in whole USD (integer; 1000.5 returns 400). Default 100000: vaults under $100k are hidden unless you pass minTvl=0. |
| `search` | query | string | no | — | Case-insensitive substring match (e.g. `usd`) on the market name, the underlying protocol name and the network name; a market matches if any of them contains the text. |
| `sortBy` | query | string: `tvl`, `fixedApy`, `liquidity`, `expiry` | no | `"tvl"` | Sort key: `tvl` (TVL in USD), `fixedApy` (fixed APY), `liquidity` (liquidity in USD), `expiry` (expiry timestamp). Case-sensitive. Default `tvl`. |
| `sortOrder` | query | string: `asc`, `desc` | no | `"desc"` | Sort direction, `asc` or `desc` (lowercase). Default `desc` on this endpoint. |
| `allowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | `["base", "mainnet", "arbitrum", "optimism"]` | Networks to include, by name (`base`) or CAIP-2 (`eip155:8453`). Default when omitted: base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism ONLY; data on every other network is silently excluded, so list each network you need. Unknown values are echoed in `errors.unsupportedNetworks` with HTTP 200. Some names returned by GET /v2/networks currently have no indexed vaults (observed 2026-10-24: `swellchain`); list endpoints echo them in `errors.unsupportedNetworks` while still returning rows for the other networks, so treat that echo as a warning, not a failure. For a complete pull, take network names from GET /v2/vaults (see https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/conventions). Repeat the key once per value (`allowedNetworks=a&allowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to exclude (name or CAIP-2). Ignored when `allowedNetworks` is set. When `allowedNetworks` is omitted, passing `disallowedNetworks` REPLACES the default network scope: every network except the listed ones is searched (verified 2026-10-24: `disallowedNetworks=mainnet` alone returned vaults on 20 networks). Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedNetworks=a&disallowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -sS 'https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/fixed-term/?perPage=3&sortBy=fixedApy&sortOrder=desc' \
  -H "x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY"
```

# [Beta] Build unsigned Pendle swap-in/swap-out txs
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/fixed-term-pendle/create-fixed-term-transaction

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. Builds UNSIGNED Pendle swap transactions: `swap-in` (underlying asset -> PT) or `swap-out` (PT -> asset). `assetAddress` is the token you send; `amount` (required) is in that token's base units. Returns ordered `actions[]` to sign and send in order. `simulate` is accepted but ignored (no simulation is returned). Cost: 5 credits. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/fixed-term-pendle/create-fixed-term-transaction.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/fixed-term/transactions/{action}/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 5 credits ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `createFixedTermTransaction`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `action` | path | string: `swap-in`, `swap-out` | yes | — | `swap-in` = underlying asset -> PT (buy the fixed rate); `swap-out` = PT -> underlying asset. |
| `userAddress` | path | string | yes | — | Wallet that will sign and send the transaction (receives the PT or asset). EVM address: 0x + 40 hex characters (checksum optional). ENS names such as vitalik.eth are not resolved (400). |
| `network` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Network name (e.g. `base`, `mainnet`) or CAIP-2 ID (e.g. `eip155:8453`). Bare chain IDs (`8453`) and `ethereum` are rejected with 400. List all with GET /v2/networks. |
| `vaultId` | path | string | yes | — | Pendle market `vaultId` from GET /beta/fixed-term/ (`data[].vaultId`, the market address). A market that does not exist returns 404. |
| `assetAddress` | query | string | yes | — | Token you send: the underlying asset address for swap-in, or the PT address for swap-out (from the fixed-term market response). |
| `amount` | query | string, pattern `^[0-9]+$` | yes | — | Amount to swap, integer string in base units of the token you send (asset for swap-in, PT for swap-out). |
| `simulate` | query | boolean | no | `false` | Accepted but ignored: no simulation is run or returned. Simulate client-side (e.g. eth_call) before signing. |

## Example request

```bash
  -H "x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY"
```

Response headers: `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-ratelimit-reset` (see [Errors, rate limits and retries](/api-reference/errors)).

# [Beta] List vaults with opt-in advanced analytics (POST)
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/advanced-analytics/list-advanced-vault-analytics

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. POST. Lists vaults (filters, sorting and pagination in the query string, mirroring /v2/detailed-vaults, including the default allowedNetworks = base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism and minTvl = 100000; unlike v2, `disallowedNetworks` alone does not lift that default) with opt-in analytics per item chosen in the JSON body: {"select": {"maxDrawdown": true, "withdrawalPauseRatio": true, "composition": true, "utilizationRate": true, "detailedVault": true}}. Set wanted sections to true and omit the rest (false returns 400; an empty or missing body returns 400). `utilizationRate` is returned per list item when selected (decimal fraction 0-1, verified 2026-10-24; may be null for vaults without a utilization concept). Request all wanted sections in one list call: credits = 1 + per item the sum of the selected sections. Cost: 1 credit + per returned item the sum of the selected sections (maxDrawdown 2, detailedVault 3, withdrawalPauseRatio 2, composition 3, utilizationRate 3). Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/advanced-analytics/list-advanced-vault-analytics.

## Request

`POST https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/advanced-analytics`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. Without a key this endpoint returns 402 (x402 payment challenge); an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 1 credit + per item the selected sections ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `listAdvancedAnalytics`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `page` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `0` | Zero-based page index (default 0). Request the response's `nextPage` until that key is absent (it is omitted, never null, on the last page); a page past the end returns 200 with empty `data`. There is no total count. |
| `perPage` | query | integer (> 0, ≤ 5000) | no | `50` | Items per page, 1-5000 (default 50). 0 or more than 5000 returns 400. Every returned item is billed (see x-credits); request only what you need. |
| `allowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to include, by ticker symbol (case-insensitive, e.g. `USDC`); token addresses are NOT accepted and are echoed in `errors.unsupportedAssets`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedAssets=a&allowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to exclude, by ticker symbol. Ignored when `allowedAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedAssets=a&disallowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to include: protocol `name` or exact `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. A name matches EVERY protocolId with that name: `morpho` = `morpho-metamorpho` (Morpho V1 / MetaMorpho vaults) + `morpho-v2` (Morpho V2 vaults) + `morpho-market` (borrow markets); `aave` matches 8 protocolIds. Use the protocolId to select one product, e.g. `morpho-metamorpho` for Morpho V1 only, or `aave-collateral vault-v3` for Aave v3 (it contains a space: send `aave-collateral%20vault-v3`). Guessed IDs such as `aave-v3` return 200 with empty `data` and the value in `errors.unsupportedProtocols`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedProtocols=a&allowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to exclude, by `name` or `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. Ignored when `allowedProtocols` is set (the allow-list wins). Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedProtocols=a&disallowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `minTvl` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `100000` | Minimum vault TVL in whole USD (integer; 1000.5 returns 400). Default 100000: vaults under $100k are hidden unless you pass minTvl=0. |
| `minVaultScore` | query | number (≥ 0) | no | — | Minimum Reputation Score (0-100, compared with `score.vaultScore`). Check `score.vaultScore` client-side if you need a strict threshold. |
| `onlyTransactional` | query | boolean | no | — | true = only vaults that /v2/transactions can build payloads for (`isTransactional: true`). Pass true before recommending a vault you will deposit into. Literal `true`/`false` only. |
| `onlyAppFeatured` | query | boolean | no | — | true = only vaults featured in app.vaults.fyi. Literal `true`/`false` only. |
| `allowCorrupted` | query | boolean | no | `false` | true = include vaults flagged as corrupted (unreliable data). Default false. |
| `allowVaultsWithWarnings` | query | boolean | no | `true` | Include vaults that have active `warnings` (e.g. bad debt, compromised keys). Default true: warned vaults ARE returned; pass false, or inspect `warnings` and `flags`, before recommending a vault. |
| `allowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | `["base", "mainnet", "arbitrum", "optimism"]` | Networks to include, by name (`base`) or CAIP-2 (`eip155:8453`). Default when omitted: base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism ONLY; data on every other network is silently excluded, so list each network you need. Unknown values are echoed in `errors.unsupportedNetworks` with HTTP 200. Some names returned by GET /v2/networks currently have no indexed vaults (observed 2026-10-24: `swellchain`); list endpoints echo them in `errors.unsupportedNetworks` while still returning rows for the other networks, so treat that echo as a warning, not a failure. For a complete pull, take network names from GET /v2/vaults (see https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/conventions). Repeat the key once per value (`allowedNetworks=a&allowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to exclude (name or CAIP-2). Ignored when `allowedNetworks` is set. Unlike v2, on this endpoint `disallowedNetworks` alone does NOT lift the default network scope: the default allowedNetworks (base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism) still applies, so `disallowedNetworks=mainnet` searches only base, arbitrum and optimism. To search every other network, pass `allowedNetworks` explicitly. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedNetworks=a&disallowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `maxTvl` | query | integer | no | — | Maximum TVL in whole USD (integer). |
| `maxApy` | query | number | no | — | Maximum APY (in decimal) of the vaults to be included. |
| `minApy` | query | number | no | — | Minimum APY (in decimal) of the vaults to be included. |
| `tags` | query | array of string | no | — | Tags from GET /v2/tags to include, e.g. `Liquid Staking`. Use exact tag names: matching is case-insensitive, but abbreviations such as `lst` return 200 with empty data. Repeat the key once per value (`tags=a&tags=b`). A comma-separated value (`tags=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `curators` | query | array of string | no | — | Curator `name`s from GET /v2/curators to include, exactly as listed (full names such as `Steakhouse Financial`; a partial name such as `Steakhouse` matches nothing). | `sortOrder` | query | string: `asc`, `desc` | no | `"asc"` | Sort direction, `asc` or `desc` (lowercase; `DESC` returns 400). Default `asc`: pass `desc` to get the highest values first. |
| `sortBy` | query | string: `tvl`, `apy1day`, `apy7day`, `apy30day`, `apy90day` | no | — | Sort key: `tvl` (TVL in USD), `apy1day` (1-day total APY), `apy7day` (7-day total APY), `apy30day` (30-day total APY), `apy90day` (90-day total APY). # [Beta] Get opt-in advanced analytics for one vault (POST)
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/advanced-analytics/get-advanced-vault-analytics

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. POST. Returns advanced analytics for one vault, sections chosen in the JSON body `select`: maxDrawdown (mdd30days/mdd90days/mdd365days, decimal fractions), withdrawalPauseRatio (0-1, or null when not tracked), composition (underlying positions; `vaultId` may be a Morpho market id), utilizationRate (0-1) and the full v2 `detailedVault`. Set wanted sections to true and omit the rest (false returns 400). Cost: 1 credit + per returned item the sum of the selected sections (maxDrawdown 2, detailedVault 3, withdrawalPauseRatio 2, composition 3, utilizationRate 3). Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/advanced-analytics/get-advanced-vault-analytics.

## Request

`POST https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/advanced-analytics/{network}/{vaultId}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. Without a key this endpoint returns 402 (x402 payment challenge); an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 1 credit + per item the selected sections ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `getAdvancedAnalytics`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `network` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Network name (e.g. `base`, `mainnet`) or CAIP-2 ID (e.g. `eip155:8453`). Bare chain IDs (`8453`) and `ethereum` are rejected with 400. List all with GET /v2/networks. |
| `vaultId` | path | string | yes | — | Vault identifier: `vaultId` from GET /v2/vaults or /v2/detailed-vaults, an opaque string. Either the vault contract address, or `<address>-<descriptor>` for vaults that share one contract (e.g. `0x559756d476D5ed4533edC3Ac98E5A9468176378c-25`): copy it, don't derive it from `address`. The address part is case-insensitive; pass the descriptor exactly as returned. A vault that migrates to a new contract gets a new vaultId. Must belong to `{network}`; otherwise 400 'Vault ... on network ... not found'. Non-vault strings return 400 'not a valid vault id'. |

## Request body

JSON body (required).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| - | - | - | - |
| `select` | object | no | Choose which analytics sections to include in the response. Pricing scales with the selection. |
| `select.maxDrawdown` | boolean: `true` | no | Include max-drawdown metrics for vault price per share |
| `select.detailedVault` | boolean: `true` | no | Embed the full v2 detailedVault payload |
| `select.withdrawalPauseRatio` | boolean: `true` | no | Include ratio of time the vault withdrawals were paused over the last 2 years. Returns null when the protocol does not expose a withdrawal-pause event source or the underlying tracked event has not yet been backfilled. |
| `select.composition` | boolean: `true` | no | Include composition for the vault. |
| `select.utilizationRate` | boolean: `true` | no | Include the share of vault assets currently utilized, as a decimal (e.g. 0.8 = 80%). |

```json
  }
}
```

# [Beta] Get a wallet's returns in one vault over a window
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/get-partial-returns

> Beta endpoint: may change before general availability. Returns a wallet's returns in one vault over a time window: `returnsNative` (underlying base units, integer string) plus the resolved `fromTimestamp`/`toTimestamp` (Unix seconds) and asset metadata. `fromTimestamp` is required (Unix seconds); `toTimestamp` defaults to the latest aggregation. Use /v2/portfolio/total-returns for lifetime returns. Cost: 2 credits. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/portfolio/get-partial-returns.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/beta/portfolio/partial-returns/{userAddress}/{network}/{vaultId}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: 2 credits ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: beta: stable in practice, but the shape may change without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `getPartialReturns`. Section: [Beta endpoints](/api-reference/beta).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `userAddress` | path | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | — | Wallet address whose data is returned. EVM address: 0x + 40 hex characters (checksum optional). ENS names such as vitalik.eth are not resolved (400). |
| `network` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Network name (e.g. `base`, `mainnet`) or CAIP-2 ID (e.g. `eip155:8453`). Bare chain IDs (`8453`) and `ethereum` are rejected with 400. List all with GET /v2/networks. |
| `vaultId` | path | string | yes | — | Vault identifier: `vaultId` from GET /v2/vaults or /v2/detailed-vaults, an opaque string. Either the vault contract address, or `<address>-<descriptor>` for vaults that share one contract (e.g. `0x559756d476D5ed4533edC3Ac98E5A9468176378c-25`): copy it, don't derive it from `address`. The address part is case-insensitive; pass the descriptor exactly as returned. A vault that migrates to a new contract gets a new vaultId. Must belong to `{network}`; otherwise 400 'Vault ... on network ... not found'. Non-vault strings return 400 'not a valid vault id'. |
| `fromTimestamp` | query | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 99999999999) | yes | — | Start of the returns window (inclusive), Unix seconds. Required (omitting it returns 400 'received nan'). |
| `toTimestamp` | query | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 99999999999) | no | — | End of the returns window (inclusive), Unix seconds. Default: the latest available vault aggregation timestamp. |

# Alpha endpoints: cross-chain intents, CCTP bridge, flows, holders
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/alpha

> Index of all 11 /alpha early-access endpoints (cross-chain intents, CCTP USDC bridge, daily vault flows, historical positions and balances, vault holders) with links to every endpoint page, required inputs and usage notes.

This page indexes every `/alpha` endpoint (11 operations) and links each one to its reference page. Alpha covers cross-chain intents, the CCTP USDC bridge, daily vault flows, a wallet's historical positions and balances, and vault holders. Use it to find the right alpha endpoint and its required inputs.

Alpha endpoints are early access. They may change or be removed **without notice** and carry no stability guarantee, so don't depend on them in production flows that need stability. What each stability level promises is on [Versioning and stability](/api-reference/versioning).

Requests go to `https://api.vaults.fyi` (no version suffix; the `/alpha` prefix is part of each path) with the header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. Every API key can call /alpha endpoints. /alpha endpoints need an API key (they are currently not offered over [x402](/ai-agents/x402)); an invalid key returns 401.

Unless a row says otherwise: APY values are decimal fractions (`0.0315` = 3.15%), token amounts are integer strings in base units, timestamps are Unix seconds, and list filters that take several values use repeated keys (`allowedNetworks=base&allowedNetworks=arbitrum`). See [Conventions](/api-reference/conventions).

Alpha endpoints cost 0 credits during early access, but they still need an API key.

Alpha endpoints are free during early access; pricing may be introduced later and would be announced in the changelog.

## Cross-chain intents

Quote, execute and track intent-based moves into a vault on another chain. Only **deposits into vaults** are supported: a token-to-token quote returns 400.

| Endpoint | Use it when | Required inputs | Credits |
| - | - | - | - |
| [`POST /alpha/transactions/intent/getQuote`](/api-reference/cross-chain/create-transaction-intent-quote) | Quote a cross-chain move into a vault (only deposits into vaults are supported). Returns a Permit2 payload to sign. | Body: `userAddress`, `inputPosition`, `outputPosition`, `feeToken`, `provider` | 0 (free during early access) |
| [`POST /alpha/transactions/intent/execute`](/api-reference/cross-chain/execute-transaction-intent) | Submit a signed intent quote (`payloadSignature`, `provider`). | Body: `payloadSignature`, `provider` | 0 (free during early access) |
| [`GET /alpha/transactions/intent/status`](/api-reference/cross-chain/get-transaction-intent-status) | Track an intent. | Query: `crosschainTransactionId`, `provider` | 0 (free during early access) |

Things to know:

- The quote returns a Permit2 payload. The user signs it; you send the signature to the execute endpoint as `payloadSignature`. Never sign on the user's behalf. See [Transaction safety](/ai-agents/transaction-safety).

## CCTP bridge

Bridge USDC between networks with Circle CCTP: context, unsigned bridge and claim transactions, in-transit transfers and status.

| Endpoint | Use it when | Required inputs | Credits |
| - | - | - | - |
| [`GET /alpha/transactions/cctp/context/{userAddress}/{srcNetwork}/{dstNetwork}/{assetAddress}`](/api-reference/cctp-bridge/get-cctp-transaction-context) | Balances, fees and options before a USDC bridge. Not every enum network is supported (gnosis returns 400). | Path: `userAddress`, `srcNetwork`, `dstNetwork`, `assetAddress` | 0 (free during early access) |
| [`GET /alpha/transactions/cctp/transactions/{action}/{userAddress}/{srcNetwork}/{dstNetwork}`](/api-reference/cctp-bridge/create-cctp-transaction) | Build unsigned CCTP bridge or claim transactions. | Path: `action`, `userAddress`, `srcNetwork`, `dstNetwork` | 0 (free during early access) |
| [`GET /alpha/transactions/cctp/money-in-transit/{userAddress}`](/api-reference/cctp-bridge/list-cctp-money-in-transit) | List a wallet's CCTP transfers that have not arrived yet. | Path: `userAddress` | 0 (free during early access) |
| [`GET /alpha/transactions/cctp/status`](/api-reference/cctp-bridge/get-cctp-transaction-status) | Status of a CCTP burn. Set a polling timeout. | Query: `burnTxHash`, `srcNetwork` | 0 (free during early access) |

Things to know:

- Not every network in the `network` enum supports CCTP: `gnosis` as destination returned 400 "not supported for CCTP".
- **Poll `getCctpTransactionStatus` with a timeout** and confirm the burn transaction onchain.

## Historical flows

| Endpoint | Use it when | Required inputs | Credits |
| - | - | - | - |
| [`GET /alpha/historical/{network}/{vaultId}/daily-flows`](/api-reference/historical/get-historical-daily-vault-flows) | Daily inflows and outflows for one vault. `fromDate` / `toDate` are `YYYY-MM-DD` strings; flows are base-unit strings. | Path: `network`, `vaultId`; Query: `fromDate`, `toDate` | 0 (free during early access) |

`fromDate` and `toDate` are `YYYY-MM-DD` strings, not Unix timestamps. `totalDeposits` and `totalRedemptions` are integer strings in the vault asset's base units (USDC: divide by 10^6).

## Historical positions

| Endpoint | Use it when | Required inputs | Credits |
| - | - | - | - |
| [`GET /alpha/historical-positions/{userAddress}`](/api-reference/historical-positions/list-user-historical-positions) | A wallet's past vault positions (latency around 40 s). | Path: `userAddress` | 0 (free during early access) |

This endpoint took about 40 s on a busy wallet. Use a client timeout of at least 60 s.

## Historical balances

| Endpoint | Use it when | Required inputs | Credits |
| - | - | - | - |
| [`GET /alpha/historical-balances/{userAddress}/{timestamp}`](/api-reference/historical-positions/list-user-historical-balances) | A wallet's vault balances at one Unix-seconds `timestamp`. Default 4-network scope. | Path: `userAddress`, `timestamp` | 0 (free during early access) |

This endpoint (about 13 s on a busy wallet) takes a Unix-**seconds** `timestamp` in the path and has the same default 4-network scope as v2 positions (base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism). Pass `allowedNetworks` (repeated key) for others.

## Holders

| Endpoint | Use it when | Required inputs | Credits |
| - | - | - | - |
| [`GET /alpha/{network}/{vaultId}/holders`](/api-reference/holders/list-vault-holders) | Holders of one vault and their LP-token balances (`perPage` ≤ 1000, default 100). | Path: `network`, `vaultId` | 0 (free during early access) |

`balance` is the holder's LP-token (share) balance in LP-token base units (usually 18 decimals), not underlying-asset units. To convert to assets, multiply by the vault's share price (for example from [NRT share price](/api-reference/nrt/get-vault-nrt-share-price)).

Credits come from [Credits](/plans/credits): base cost per call, plus a per-item cost where shown. Pay-as-you-go is $0.002 per credit.

## Example: top holders of a vault

```bash
curl -H "x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY" \
  "https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/base/0xbeeff2490FEffa212faC2f6553682C219E6a8845/holders?perPage=2"
```

Response, captured 2026-10-23 (complete):

```json
{
  "itemsOnPage": 2,
  "nextPage": 1,
  "data": [
    { "address": "0x2F865596972C0B3567bA636325C71ebaA8Cc1238", "balance": "4952501653832690363227033" },
    { "address": "0x295e9F0B609181200bF5eeBBDb9103aDfA27D56D", "balance": "4933566597919131996363419" }
  ]
}
```

`4952501653832690363227033` / 10^18 ≈ 4,952,501.65 vault shares. The path order is `/alpha/{network}/{vaultId}/holders`: network first, with no section name before it.

# [Alpha] List a vault's current holders
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/holders/list-vault-holders

Lists current holders of one vault with their balances in LP-token (share) base units (rebasing vaults are converted to LP-token amounts). Paginated: `perPage` 1-1000 (default 100). | Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |

# [Alpha] List vaults a wallet held during a time window
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical-positions/list-user-historical-positions

> Alpha endpoint: early access, may change or be removed without notice. Returns the vaults a wallet held a position in during a window (non-zero balance at the start or a deposit during the window), with `active` flags. `fromTimestamp`/`toTimestamp` are optional Unix seconds. Slow: about 40 s observed. Cost: free (0 credits). Alpha endpoints are free during early access; an API key is still required. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical-positions/list-user-historical-positions.

# [Alpha] Get a wallet's vault balances at a past timestamp
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical-positions/list-user-historical-balances

> Alpha endpoint: early access, may change or be removed without notice. Returns the wallet's vault positions and balances at a historical Unix-seconds `timestamp`, in the v2 positions shape. Same defaults as /v2/portfolio/positions: allowedNetworks = base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism ONLY, minTvl = 100000, minUsdAssetValueThreshold = 1, apyInterval = 7day. Slow: about 13 s observed. Cost: free (0 credits). Alpha endpoints are free during early access; an API key is still required. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical-positions/list-user-historical-balances.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/historical-balances/{userAddress}/{timestamp}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: free (0 credits) ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: alpha: early access, may change or be removed without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `listHistoricalBalances`. Section: [Alpha endpoints](/api-reference/alpha).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `userAddress` | path | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | — | Wallet address whose data is returned. EVM address: 0x + 40 hex characters (checksum optional). ENS names such as vitalik.eth are not resolved (400). |
| `timestamp` | path | integer | yes | — | Point in time, Unix seconds (not milliseconds; values >= 1e11 return 400). |
| `allowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to include, by ticker symbol (case-insensitive, e.g. `USDC`); token addresses are NOT accepted and are echoed in `errors.unsupportedAssets`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedAssets=a&allowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedAssets` | query | array of string | no | — | Underlying assets to exclude, by ticker symbol. Ignored when `allowedAssets` is set. Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedAssets=a&disallowedAssets=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedAssets=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `allowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to include: protocol `name` or exact `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. A name matches EVERY protocolId with that name: `morpho` = `morpho-metamorpho` (Morpho V1 / MetaMorpho vaults) + `morpho-v2` (Morpho V2 vaults) + `morpho-market` (borrow markets); `aave` matches 8 protocolIds. Use the protocolId to select one product, e.g. `morpho-metamorpho` for Morpho V1 only, or `aave-collateral vault-v3` for Aave v3 (it contains a space: send `aave-collateral%20vault-v3`). Guessed IDs such as `aave-v3` return 200 with empty `data` and the value in `errors.unsupportedProtocols`. Repeat the key once per value (`allowedProtocols=a&allowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedProtocols` | query | array of string | no | — | Protocols to exclude, by `name` or `protocolId` from GET /v2/protocols. Ignored when `allowedProtocols` is set (the allow-list wins). Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedProtocols=a&disallowedProtocols=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedProtocols=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `minTvl` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `100000` | Minimum vault TVL in whole USD (integer; 1000.5 returns 400). Default 100000: vaults under $100k are hidden unless you pass minTvl=0 (this also hides the wallet's positions in smaller vaults). |
| `minVaultScore` | query | number (≥ 0) | no | — | Minimum Reputation Score (0-100, compared with `score.vaultScore`). Check `score.vaultScore` client-side if you need a strict threshold. |
| `onlyTransactional` | query | boolean | no | — | true = only vaults that /v2/transactions can build payloads for (`isTransactional: true`). Pass true before recommending a vault you will deposit into. Literal `true`/`false` only. |
| `onlyAppFeatured` | query | boolean | no | — | true = only vaults featured in app.vaults.fyi. Literal `true`/`false` only. |
| `allowCorrupted` | query | boolean | no | `false` | true = include vaults flagged as corrupted (unreliable data). Default false. |
| `allowVaultsWithWarnings` | query | boolean | no | `true` | Include vaults that have active `warnings` (e.g. bad debt, compromised keys). Default true: warned vaults ARE returned; pass false, or inspect `warnings` and `flags`, before recommending a vault. |
| `allowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | `["base", "mainnet", "arbitrum", "optimism"]` | Networks to include, by name (`base`) or CAIP-2 (`eip155:8453`). Default when omitted: base, mainnet, arbitrum, optimism ONLY; data on every other network is silently excluded, so list each network you need. Unknown values are echoed in `errors.unsupportedNetworks` with HTTP 200. Some names returned by GET /v2/networks currently have no indexed vaults (observed 2026-10-24: `swellchain`); list endpoints echo them in `errors.unsupportedNetworks` while still returning rows for the other networks, so treat that echo as a warning, not a failure. For a complete pull, take network names from GET /v2/vaults (see https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/conventions). Repeat the key once per value (`allowedNetworks=a&allowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`allowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `disallowedNetworks` | query | array of string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | no | — | Networks to exclude (name or CAIP-2). Ignored when `allowedNetworks` is set. When `allowedNetworks` is omitted, passing `disallowedNetworks` REPLACES the default network scope: every network except the listed ones is searched (verified 2026-10-24: `disallowedNetworks=mainnet` alone returned vaults on 20 networks). Repeat the key once per value (`disallowedNetworks=a&disallowedNetworks=b`). A comma-separated value (`disallowedNetworks=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `maxTvl` | query | integer | no | — | Maximum TVL in whole USD (integer). |
| `maxApy` | query | number | no | — | Maximum APY (in decimal) of the vaults to be included. |
| `minApy` | query | number | no | — | Minimum APY (in decimal) of the vaults to be included. |
| `tags` | query | array of string | no | — | Tags from GET /v2/tags to include, e.g. `Liquid Staking`. Use exact tag names: matching is case-insensitive, but abbreviations such as `lst` return 200 with empty data. Repeat the key once per value (`tags=a&tags=b`). A comma-separated value (`tags=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `curators` | query | array of string | no | — | Curator `name`s from GET /v2/curators to include, exactly as listed (full names such as `Steakhouse Financial`; a partial name such as `Steakhouse` matches nothing). Unknown names return empty results with no `errors` echo, so resolve the name from /v2/curators first. Repeat the key once per value (`curators=a&curators=b`). A comma-separated value (`curators=a,b`) is NOT split: it is treated as one unknown value and silently returns empty results. |
| `sortOrder` | query | string: `asc`, `desc` | no | `"asc"` | Sort direction, `asc` or `desc` (lowercase; `DESC` returns 400). Default `asc`: pass `desc` to get the highest values first. |
| `sortBy` | query | string: `balanceUsd`, `tvl`, `apy1Day`, `apy7Day`, `apy30Day`, `apy90Day` | no | — | Sort key: `balanceUsd` (position/balance value in USD), `tvl` (TVL in USD), `apy1Day` (1-day total APY), `apy7Day` (7-day total APY), `apy30Day` (30-day total APY), `apy90Day` (90-day total APY). Case-sensitive. Without sortBy the order is unspecified (not ranked): always pass sortBy and sortOrder. |
| `apyInterval` | query | string: `1day`, `7day`, `30day`, `90day` | no | `"7day"` | Trailing window used for the returned APY values and for ranking: 1day, 7day, 30day or 90day (default 7day). APY values are decimal fractions net of fees. |
| `minUsdAssetValueThreshold` | query | number (≥ 0) | no | `1` | Ignore holdings worth less than this many USD (default 1). |

# [Alpha] Get a vault's daily deposit and redemption flows
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical/get-historical-daily-vault-flows

> Alpha endpoint: early access, may change or be removed without notice. Returns daily UTC deposit and redemption totals for one vault: `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `totalDeposits`/`totalRedemptions` (approximate, underlying-asset base units, integer strings), counts and unique depositors/redeemers. `fromDate` inclusive, `toDate` exclusive, both YYYY-MM-DD (other formats return 400). Paginated: `perPage` up to 366. Cost: free (0 credits). Alpha endpoints are free during early access; an API key is still required. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/historical/get-historical-daily-vault-flows.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/historical/{network}/{vaultId}/daily-flows`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: free (0 credits) ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: alpha: early access, may change or be removed without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `getHistoricalDailyFlows`. Section: [Alpha endpoints](/api-reference/alpha).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `network` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Network name (e.g. `base`, `mainnet`) or CAIP-2 ID (e.g. `eip155:8453`). Bare chain IDs (`8453`) and `ethereum` are rejected with 400. List all with GET /v2/networks. |
| `vaultId` | path | string | yes | — | Vault identifier: `vaultId` from GET /v2/vaults or /v2/detailed-vaults, an opaque string. Either the vault contract address, or `<address>-<descriptor>` for vaults that share one contract (e.g. `0x559756d476D5ed4533edC3Ac98E5A9468176378c-25`): copy it, don't derive it from `address`. The address part is case-insensitive; pass the descriptor exactly as returned. A vault that migrates to a new contract gets a new vaultId. Must belong to `{network}`; otherwise 400 'Vault ... on network ... not found'. Non-vault strings return 400 'not a valid vault id'. |
| `fromDate` | query | string, pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` | yes | — | UTC start date, inclusive, `YYYY-MM-DD` (other formats return 400). |
| `toDate` | query | string, pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` | yes | — | UTC end date, EXCLUSIVE, `YYYY-MM-DD` (other formats return 400). |
| `page` | query | integer (≥ 0) | no | `0` | Zero-based page index (default 0). Request the response's `nextPage` until that key is absent (it is omitted, never null, on the last page); a page past the end returns 200 with empty `data`. There is no total count. |
| `perPage` | query | integer (> 0, ≤ 366) | no | `100` | Items per page, 1-366 (default 100). 0 or more than 366 returns 400. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -sS 'https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/historical/base/0xbeeff2490FEffa212faC2f6553682C219E6a8845/daily-flows?fromDate=2026-10-01&toDate=2026-10-05&perPage=3' \
  -H "x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY"
```

## Response (200)

Success: Get a vault's daily deposit and redemption flows

Response headers: `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-ratelimit-reset` (see [Errors, rate limits and retries](/api-reference/errors)).

| `data` | array of object | yes | Result items for this page. Item fields: `date`, `totalDeposits`, `totalRedemptions`, `depositCount`, `redemptionCount`, `uniqueDepositors`, `uniqueRedeemers`. |

# [Alpha] Quote a cross-chain deposit into a vault
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/cross-chain/create-transaction-intent-quote

> Alpha endpoint: early access, may change or be removed without notice. POST. Quotes an intent that moves `inputPosition` (token address, network, `amount` in base units) into a vault `outputPosition`, possibly on another chain. Returns `payloadToSign` (EIP-712, Permit2), `setupTransactions` (e.g. a Permit2 approval) to send first, fees and the received position. Currently only deposits into a vault are supported (a token output returns 400 'Only deposits are supported currently'), with USDC on mainnet, base, optimism and arbitrum. Nothing is signed or executed. Cost: free (0 credits). Alpha endpoints are free during early access; an API key is still required. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/cross-chain/create-transaction-intent-quote.

## Request

`POST https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/transactions/intent/getQuote`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: free (0 credits) ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: alpha: early access, may change or be removed without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `createTransactionIntentQuote`. Section: [Alpha endpoints](/api-reference/alpha).

## Request body

JSON body (required).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| - | - | - | - |
| `userAddress` | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | User wallet address |
| `inputPosition` | object | yes | Input position details |
| `inputPosition.address` | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | Token contract address |
| `inputPosition.network` | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | Network name or CAIP identifier |
| `inputPosition.amount` | string | yes | Amount in base units |
| `outputPosition` | object | yes | Output position details |
| `outputPosition.address` | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | Token contract address |
| `outputPosition.network` | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | Network name or CAIP identifier |
| `feeToken` | object | yes | Fee token details |
| `feeToken.address` | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | Fee token contract address |
| `feeToken.network` | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | Network name or CAIP identifier |
| `provider` | string: `biconomy`, `rhinestone` | yes | Provider name |

```bash
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"userAddress":"0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045","inputPosition":{"address":"0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831","network":"arbitrum","amount":"1000000"},"outputPosition":{"address":"0xbeeff2490FEffa212faC2f6553682C219E6a8845","network":"base"},"feeToken":{"address":"0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831","network":"arbitrum"},"provider":"rhinestone"}'
```

## Response (200)

Success: Quote a cross-chain deposit into a vault

Response headers: `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-ratelimit-reset` (see [Errors, rate limits and retries](/api-reference/errors)).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| - | - | - | - |
| `payloadToSign` | object | yes | EIP-712 payload for user to sign Fields: `domain`, `types`, `message`, `primaryType`. |
| `setupTransactions` | object | no | Transactions that need to be executed before the intent execution. Grouped by chain ID. |

| `receivedAssetValue` | object | yes | Underlying asset value of the received position Fields: `address`, `network`, `decimals`, `amount`. |
| `expirationTimestamp` | number | no | Timestamp when the quote expires. Unix seconds. |
| `originalQuote` | any | no | Original quote data from the intent service |

# [Alpha] Get balances, fees and steps before a CCTP bridge
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/cctp-bridge/get-cctp-transaction-context

> Alpha endpoint: early access, may change or be removed without notice. Returns the wallet's USDC balance and allowance (base units), fees (`standardTransferFeeBps`/`fastTransferFeeBps` in basis points, `forwardingFeeNative` in base units), bridge steps and transfers still in transit for a source/destination pair. CCTP currently supports mainnet, arbitrum and base only, although the enum lists more networks: others return 400 (e.g. gnosis: 'not supported for CCTP'). Cost: free (0 credits). Alpha endpoints are free during early access; an API key is still required. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/cctp-bridge/get-cctp-transaction-context.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/transactions/cctp/context/{userAddress}/{srcNetwork}/{dstNetwork}/{assetAddress}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: free (0 credits) ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: alpha: early access, may change or be removed without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `getCctpTransactionContext`. Section: [Alpha endpoints](/api-reference/alpha).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `userAddress` | path | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | — | Wallet address whose data is returned. EVM address: 0x + 40 hex characters (checksum optional). ENS names such as vitalik.eth are not resolved (400). |
| `srcNetwork` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Source network of the CCTP transfer, name (e.g. `base`) or CAIP-2. Not every enum value supports CCTP: `gnosis` returns 400 'not supported for CCTP'. |
| `dstNetwork` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Destination network of the CCTP transfer, name (e.g. `base`) or CAIP-2. Not every enum value supports CCTP: `gnosis` returns 400 'not supported for CCTP'. |
| `assetAddress` | path | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | — | USDC token address on srcNetwork (CCTP bridges USDC), e.g. 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 on base. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -sS 'https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/transactions/cctp/context/0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045/base/arbitrum/0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913' \
  -H "x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY"
```

## Response (200)

Success: Get balances, fees and steps before a CCTP bridge

Response headers: `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-ratelimit-reset` (see [Errors, rate limits and retries](/api-reference/errors)).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| - | - | - | - |
| `asset` | object | yes | Underlying asset (address, CAIP-19 assetCaip, symbol, decimals) and, where present, balances in base units / USD. Fields: `address`, `symbol`, `decimals`, `name`, `balanceNative`, `allowance`. |
| `fees` | object | yes | Fees for forwarding mode (fetched from Iris API) Fields: `standardTransferFeeBps`, `fastTransferFeeBps`, `forwardingFeeNative`. |
| `currentBridgeStep` | string: `bridge`, `claim` | yes | Name of the bridge step to execute next; matches an `action` value. |
| `bridgeSteps` | array of object | yes | Bridge steps that apply to this wallet and target. Each has `name` (the action to request), `actions` (transactions it produces) and `actionsUrl`. Item fields: `name`, `actions`, `actionsUrl`. |
| `moneyInTransit` | array of object | yes | Recent CCTP transfers that are still in transit Item fields: `burnToken`, `amountNative`, `mintRecipient`, `destinationDomain`, `status`, `message`, `attestation`, `depositor`. |
| `srcNetwork` | object | yes | Source network Fields: `name`, `chainId`, `networkCaip`. |
| `dstNetwork` | object | yes | Source network Fields: `name`, `chainId`, `networkCaip`. |

# [Alpha] Build unsigned CCTP bridge or claim txs
Source: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/cctp-bridge/create-cctp-transaction

> Alpha endpoint: early access, may change or be removed without notice. Builds UNSIGNED CCTP transactions: `bridge` (burn USDC on srcNetwork; `amount` in base units, `transferType` standard|fast) or `claim` (mint on dstNetwork; requires `message` and `attestation` from the status endpoint). Returns ordered `actions[]` to sign and send in order. Cost: free (0 credits). Alpha endpoints are free during early access; an API key is still required. Docs: https://docs.vaults.fyi/api-reference/cctp-bridge/create-cctp-transaction.

## Request

`GET https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/transactions/cctp/transactions/{action}/{userAddress}/{srcNetwork}/{dstNetwork}`

- Auth: header `x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY`. This endpoint needs an API key; an invalid key returns 401.
- Credits: free (0 credits) ([Credits](/plans/credits)).
- Stability: alpha: early access, may change or be removed without notice ([Versioning](/api-reference/versioning)).
- operationId: `createCctpTransaction`. Section: [Alpha endpoints](/api-reference/alpha).

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| - | - | - | - | - | - |
| `action` | path | string: `bridge`, `claim` | yes | — | `bridge` burns USDC on srcNetwork; `claim` mints it on dstNetwork once attested (needs `message` and `attestation`). |
| `userAddress` | path | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | yes | — | Wallet that will sign the bridge/claim transactions. EVM address: 0x + 40 hex characters (checksum optional). ENS names such as vitalik.eth are not resolved (400). |
| `srcNetwork` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Source network of the CCTP transfer, name (e.g. `base`) or CAIP-2. Not every enum value supports CCTP: `gnosis` returns 400 'not supported for CCTP'. |
| `dstNetwork` | path | string: one of 44 values (`mainnet`, `optimism`, `arbitrum`, …; full list in the OpenAPI block) | yes | — | Destination network of the CCTP transfer, name (e.g. `base`) or CAIP-2. Not every enum value supports CCTP: `gnosis` returns 400 'not supported for CCTP'. |
| `amount` | query | string, pattern `^[0-9]+$` | no | — | USDC to bridge, integer string in base units (1 USDC = "1000000"). Required for action=bridge. |
| `useForwarding` | query | boolean | no | `false` | true = use Circle's forwarding (relay) service so the destination mint is claimed automatically (a forwarding fee applies, see `fees.forwardingFeeNative` in the context). Default false. |
| `transferType` | query | string: `standard`, `fast` | no | `"standard"` | `standard` (no service fee, slower) or `fast` (fee `fees.fastTransferFeeBps` basis points). Only for action=bridge. Default `standard`. |
| `recipientAddress` | query | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | no | — | Recipient on dstNetwork (0x + 40 hex). Default: userAddress. |
| `assetAddress` | query | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]{40}$` | no | — | USDC token address on srcNetwork. Default: USDC on srcNetwork. |
| `message` | query | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]*$` | no | — | CCTP message bytes (hex) from GET /alpha/transactions/cctp/status once attested. Required for action=claim. |
| `attestation` | query | string, pattern `^0x[a-fA-F0-9]*$` | no | — | Circle attestation (hex) from GET /alpha/transactions/cctp/status. Required for action=claim. |

## Example request

```bash
curl -sS 'https://api.vaults.fyi/alpha/transactions/cctp/transactions/bridge/0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045/base/arbitrum?amount=1000000&assetAddress=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913&transferType=fast' \
  -H "x-api-key: $VAULTSFYI_API_KEY"
```

## Response (200)

Success: Build unsigned CCTP bridge or claim txs

Response headers: `x-ratelimit-limit`, `x-ratelimit-remaining`, `x-ratelimit-reset` (see [Errors, rate limits and retries](/api-reference/errors)).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| - | - | - | - |
| `currentActionIndex` | number | yes | Index in `actions` of the first step still to execute (0 for a fresh flow). |
| `actions` | array of object | yes | Ordered unsigned transactions. Sign and send each in order and wait for its receipt before the next (e.g. approve, then deposit). Verify `tx.to` and `tx.chainId` before signing. Item fields: `name`, `tx`, `simulation`. |

```json
  "currentActionIndex": 0,

    {
```
